## Setup

This document compares GBIF occurrence documentation for the Makay and Isalo
protected areas (Madagascar). It is the corrected output of a reproducibility
audit (2026-11-13) of an earlier version of this report; every methodological
change is documented inline and in `audit_report.md`.

The pipeline reads a GBIF occurrence download stored as a partitioned parquet
dataset, and the World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) polygons for the two
sites.

```{r}
library(arrow) # to read parquet
library(tidyverse) # for data manipulation
library(scales) # scale conversion
library(sf) # vector spatial data
library(tmap) # map visualization

# define paths
wdpa_zip <- "data/raw/wdpa/WDPA_Jul2026_MDG-shapefile.zip"
wdpa_gdb <- "data/raw/wdpa/WDPA_WDOECM_Jul2026_Public_MDG.gdb"
parquet_dir <- "data/parquet/gbif_madagascar"
dataset_names_path <- "outputs/gbif_dataset_names.csv"
# keep consistent colors across document
area_colors <- c(Makay = "#3b7a57", Isalo = "#c85c3e")
```

## Provenance

All occurrence data come from a single GBIF occurrence download:

- **Download key**: `0000459-260720095953322`; **DOI**: [10.15468/dl.ufwdju](https://doi.org/10.15468/dl.ufwdju)
- **Created** 2026-07-20 19:51 UTC, completed 22:53 UTC; format `SIMPLE_CSV` (50 columns)
- **Predicate**: `occurrenceStatus = PRESENT` AND `country = MG` (Madagascar)
- **3,635,415 records** from 2,006 datasets, licensed **CC BY-NC 4.0**
- Converted to a lon/lat-partitioned parquet dataset by
  `R/convert_gbif_madagascar_to_parquet.R`. The audit found and fixed two
  conversion defects in the superseded converter (see *Audit notes* at the end
  of this document): silently dropped records caused by malformed quoting in
  the source CSV (262 records with stray unescaped `"` characters caused
  readr's chunked reader to lose ~300,486 records), and 70,239,134 all-NA
  "phantom" rows created by `NA`-propagating logical subsetting. The corrected
  dataset contains exactly 3,635,415 records (verified against the GBIF API)
  and all 50 source columns, including `kingdom`, `phylum`, `taxonRank`,
  `taxonKey` and `speciesKey`.

Protected-area boundaries come from the **WDPA/WDOECM July 2026 public
release** (`WDPA_Jul2026_MDG-shapefile.zip`, MD5
`d96a919e7ce1ed8389c9da863f692d8d`, internal file dates 2026-07-16). The
cached archive is read directly with GDAL's OpenFileGDB driver. (The
`wdpar::wdpa_fetch()` download-page scraping used previously no longer works;
`wdpa_read()` performed no geometry processing beyond unzipping, so reading
the geodatabase directly reproduces the same polygons.)

```{r}
# extract the geodatabase from the cached WDPA zip if needed
if (!dir.exists(wdpa_gdb)) {
  utils::unzip(wdpa_zip, exdir = dirname(wdpa_zip))
}

protected_areas <- st_read(wdpa_gdb, layer = "WDPA_WDOECM_poly_Jul2026_MDG", quiet = TRUE) |>
  mutate(area = coalesce(NAME_ENG, NAME)) |>
  filter(str_detect(area, regex("makay|isalo", ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  rename(geometry = SHAPE) |>
  select(area, SITE_ID, DESIG_ENG, IUCN_CAT, STATUS, STATUS_YR, REP_AREA, GIS_AREA, geometry) |>
  # Area on the ellipsoidal equal-area projection EPSG:6933; this reproduces
  # WDPA's own GIS_AREA column exactly. The earlier report used EPSG:29702
  # (Laborde, conformal: 4,052 / 866 km²) and an earlier script used geodesic
  # area on the WGS84 ellipsoid (4,067 / 869 km²); see audit notes.
  mutate(AREA_KM2 = as.numeric(st_area(st_transform(geometry, 6933))) / 1000000) |>
  st_transform(4326)
```

## Protected areas

Both polygons are WDPA site polygons, not geomorphological outlines of the
massifs: Isalo (WDPA site 2312) is a national park (IUCN category II,
designated 1962); Makay (WDPA site 555790177) is a proposed protected area
("Aire Protégée", status Proposed, 2015). The two polygons do not overlap and
there is exactly one polygon per site.

```{r}
tmap_mode("view")

tm_shape(protected_areas) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "area",
    palette = area_colors,
    alpha = 0.7,
    border.col = "#1f1f1f",
    lwd = 1.5,
    id = "area"
  ) +
  tm_text("area")
```

## Madagascar GBIF and filtering

The filtering workflow starts from all 3,635,415 PRESENT records of the GBIF
Madagascar download, narrows the data to the parquet partitions touched by the
two protected areas (a prefilter to avoid loading the full extract), keeps
records inside the rectangular bounding box of each area, and finally keeps
only points within the exact WDPA polygons (`st_within`, so the polygons
themselves — not their bounding boxes — define the study areas).

```{r}
# columns used in this document
required_columns <- c(
  "gbifID", "decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude", "species", "scientificName",
  "year", "datasetKey", "basisOfRecord", "kingdom", "phylum", "class",
  "taxonRank", "speciesKey", "genus", "family",
  "coordinateUncertaintyInMeters", "occurrenceStatus"
)

# per-area bounding boxes (computed per feature, then floored to 1-degree bins)
bbox_matrix <- t(vapply(
  st_geometry(protected_areas),
  \(geometry) unname(st_bbox(geometry)),
  numeric(4)
))
colnames(bbox_matrix) <- c("xmin", "ymin", "xmax", "ymax")
area_bboxes <- as_tibble(bbox_matrix) |>
  mutate(area = protected_areas$area)

candidate_occurrences <- open_dataset(parquet_dir) |>
  select(any_of(c(required_columns, "lon_bin", "lat_bin"))) |>
  filter(
    lon_bin %in% 44:45,
    lat_bin %in% -23:-21,
    !is.na(decimalLongitude),
    !is.na(decimalLatitude),
    is.na(occurrenceStatus) | occurrenceStatus == "PRESENT"
  ) |>
  collect()

bbox_counts <- candidate_occurrences |>
  mutate(
    in_isalo = decimalLongitude >= area_bboxes$xmin[area_bboxes$area == "Isalo"] &
      decimalLongitude <= area_bboxes$xmax[area_bboxes$area == "Isalo"] &
      decimalLatitude >= area_bboxes$ymin[area_bboxes$area == "Isalo"] &
      decimalLatitude <= area_bboxes$ymax[area_bboxes$area == "Isalo"],
    in_makay = decimalLongitude >= area_bboxes$xmin[area_bboxes$area == "Makay"] &
      decimalLongitude <= area_bboxes$xmax[area_bboxes$area == "Makay"] &
      decimalLatitude >= area_bboxes$ymin[area_bboxes$area == "Makay"] &
      decimalLatitude <= area_bboxes$ymax[area_bboxes$area == "Makay"]
  ) |>
  summarise(Isalo = sum(in_isalo), Makay = sum(in_makay)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "area", values_to = "record_count") |>
  mutate(step = "Inside bounding box")

area_occurrences <- candidate_occurrences |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) |>
  st_join(protected_areas |> select(area), join = st_within, left = FALSE) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(record_year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year)))

filtering_steps <- tibble(
  step = c(
    "GBIF Madagascar download (PRESENT records, verified against the GBIF API)",
    "Candidate records read from parquet bins (with coordinates)",
    "Inside bounding box",
    "Clipped to exact WDPA polygon (st_within)"
  ),
  record_count = c(
    3635415L,
    nrow(candidate_occurrences),
    sum(bbox_counts$record_count),
    nrow(area_occurrences)
  )
) |>
  mutate(share_of_madagascar = record_count / first(record_count))
```

```{r}
filtering_steps |>
  mutate(
    across(record_count, comma),
    share_of_madagascar = percent(share_of_madagascar, accuracy = 0.01)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Filtering pipeline from the GBIF Madagascar download to the polygon-clipped occurrences")
```

The bbox stage removes most of the Madagascar archive before loading to
memory, and the polygon stage then removes additional records that fall inside
the rectangular extent but outside the protected-area boundary.

## Species definition (audit correction)

The earlier report counted "species" as
`species_label = coalesce(species, scientificName)`. This construction counts
**identifications of any rank** as species: when GBIF's `species` field is
empty (genus-, family- or order-level identifications, and unmatched names),
the fallback `scientificName` contributes labels such as *Diptera*,
*Chironomidae* or *Grewia* (with or without authorship) that are not species.
In the earlier data the top "species" of Isalo by record count were *Diptera*
(2,071), *Coleoptera* (1,941) and *Chironomidae* (1,859) — all higher-rank
labels.

This document counts **accepted species** with the GBIF backbone identifier
`speciesKey`, which is populated only for identifications at or below species
rank and resolves synonyms to the accepted species. Two properties were
verified in the data: (i) no record with a species-rank identification lacks a
`speciesKey` (none are lost by this definition), and (ii) `speciesKey` and
`species` agree except for six name strings shared by two homotypic backbone
keys, so keys are used throughout. Records identified only above species rank
(66% of Isalo occurrences, largely bulk arthropod samples identified to
family/order; 33% of Makay occurrences, largely genus-level plant
determinations) are retained in occurrence counts but contribute to no species
count; they are reported separately as higher-rank identifications.

```{r}
higher_rank_labels <- area_occurrences |>
  filter(is.na(speciesKey), !is.na(scientificName)) |>
  count(area, scientificName, sort = TRUE) |>
  group_by(area) |>
  slice_head(n = 8) |>
  ungroup() |>
  rename(higher_rank_label = scientificName)

rank_breakdown <- area_occurrences |>
  filter(is.na(speciesKey)) |>
  count(area, taxonRank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = area, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  arrange(desc(Isalo))
```

```{r}
rank_breakdown |>
  mutate(across(Isalo:Makay, comma)) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Records without an accepted-species identifier, by identification rank")
```

```{r}
higher_rank_labels |>
  mutate(across(n, comma)) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Most frequent higher-rank identification labels (not counted as species)")
```

## Taxonomic scope comparison

The manuscript focuses on plants, so the comparison is reported for three
nested scopes: all taxa, Plantae (as assigned by the GBIF backbone — including
bryophytes and algae classified in Plantae), and vascular plants (phylum
Tracheophyta).

```{r}
scope_comparison <- bind_rows(
  area_occurrences |> mutate(scope_name = "All taxa"),
  area_occurrences |> filter(kingdom == "Plantae") |>
    mutate(scope_name = "Plantae (GBIF backbone)"),
  area_occurrences |> filter(kingdom == "Plantae", phylum == "Tracheophyta") |>
    mutate(scope_name = "Vascular plants (Tracheophyta)")
) |>
  summarise(
    occurrences = n(),
    accepted_species = n_distinct(speciesKey[!is.na(speciesKey)]),
    higher_rank_only_records = sum(is.na(speciesKey)),
    .by = c(scope_name, area)
  ) |>
  left_join(protected_areas |> st_drop_geometry() |> select(area, AREA_KM2), by = "area") |>
  mutate(
    occurrence_density_per_100_km2 = occurrences / AREA_KM2 * 100,
    species_density_per_100_km2 = accepted_species / AREA_KM2 * 100
  )
```

```{r}
scope_comparison |>
  transmute(
    scope_name,
    area,
    area_km2 = round(AREA_KM2, 1),
    occurrences = comma(occurrences),
    accepted_species = comma(accepted_species),
    higher_rank_only_records = comma(higher_rank_only_records),
    occ_per_100_km2 = round(occurrence_density_per_100_km2, 1),
    species_per_100_km2 = round(species_density_per_100_km2, 1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "GBIF documentation by taxonomic scope (accepted species based on GBIF backbone speciesKey)")
```

For plants the raw contrast is much smaller than for all taxa: Isalo holds
`r comma(scope_comparison$accepted_species[scope_comparison$scope_name == "Vascular plants (Tracheophyta)" & scope_comparison$area == "Isalo"])`
vascular plant species against
`r comma(scope_comparison$accepted_species[scope_comparison$scope_name == "Vascular plants (Tracheophyta)" & scope_comparison$area == "Makay"])`
for Makay, whereas Isalo holds almost twice as many accepted species across
all taxa. The all-taxon asymmetry is largely produced by Isalo's bulk
arthropod and molecular sampling campaigns (see *Sampling profile*).

```{r}
ggplot(scope_comparison, aes(x = area, y = occurrence_density_per_100_km2, fill = area)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(occurrence_density_per_100_km2, 1)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ scope_name, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = area_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Occurrence density inside each protected area",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Occurrences per 100 km²"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
decade_counts <- area_occurrences |>
  filter(!is.na(record_year), between(record_year, 1800, as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")))) |>
  mutate(decade = (record_year %/% 10) * 10) |>
  summarise(occurrence_count = n(), .by = c(area, decade))

ggplot(decade_counts, aes(x = decade, y = occurrence_count, fill = area)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ area, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = area_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Occurrence history by decade",
    x = "Decade",
    y = "Occurrence count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Sampling profile

The two areas document different kinds of evidence. Isalo's record set is
dominated by molecular and bulk material samples, Makay's by herbarium and
insect specimens.

```{r}
basis_comparison <- area_occurrences |>
  count(area, basisOfRecord, name = "occurrence_count") |>
  mutate(share = occurrence_count / sum(occurrence_count), .by = area) |>
  arrange(area, desc(occurrence_count))

basis_comparison |>
  transmute(area, basisOfRecord, occurrences = comma(occurrence_count), share = percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Basis of record composition")
```

```{r}
# dataset contributions, with titles fetched from the GBIF dataset API
# (outputs/gbif_dataset_names.csv, fetched 2026-11-13)
dataset_names <- if (file.exists(dataset_names_path)) read_csv(dataset_names_path, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL

dataset_stats <- area_occurrences |>
  count(area, datasetKey, name = "occurrences") |>
  mutate(share = occurrences / sum(occurrences), .by = area) |>
  arrange(area, desc(occurrences))

top_datasets <- dataset_stats |>
  group_by(area) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(dataset_names, by = "datasetKey") |>
  mutate(dataset_title = coalesce(dataset_title, datasetKey))

top_datasets |>
  transmute(area, dataset = dataset_title, occurrences = comma(occurrences), share = percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Five largest contributing datasets per area")
```

Isalo's material-sample mass comes from the International Barcode of Life
project (29% of all Isalo records), CO1 amplicon sequence variants of bulk
arthropod samples (16%) and the Global soil organisms dataset (15%); eBird
checklists add another 16%. Makay's records are dominated by Missouri
Botanical Garden herbarium specimens (Tropicos: 45% of all Makay records) and
AntWeb (26%). Within vascular plants, ~90% of Makay's GBIF plant records are
Tropicos herbarium specimens, while Isalo's plant records are more mixed
(iNaturalist 34%, Tropicos 29%, MNHN herbarium 13%).

Records are also strongly concentrated in space: **four distinct coordinate
pairs hold 50% of all Isalo occurrences** (the most frequent pair holds 23%),
consistent with bulk samples georeferenced to site or park centroids, whereas
Makay's records are far less repeated (top pair 3%; 43 distinct coordinates
needed to reach 50%). Occurrence densities therefore partly reflect
georeferencing practice rather than sampling intensity alone.

## Species overlap

```{r}
species_presence <- area_occurrences |>
  filter(!is.na(speciesKey)) |>
  distinct(area, speciesKey)

shared_species_count <- species_presence |> count(speciesKey) |> filter(n == 2) |> nrow()
unique_species <- species_presence |>
  add_count(speciesKey, name = "area_count") |>
  filter(area_count == 1) |>
  select(area, speciesKey)
species_union_count <- n_distinct(species_presence$speciesKey)
species_total_count <- nrow(species_presence)

overlap_metrics <- tibble(
  shared_species_count = shared_species_count,
  species_union_count = species_union_count,
  jaccard_similarity = shared_species_count / species_union_count,
  sorensen_similarity = 2 * shared_species_count / species_total_count
)

scope_presence_list <- list(
  "All taxa" = species_presence,
  "Plantae (GBIF backbone)" = area_occurrences |>
    filter(kingdom == "Plantae", !is.na(speciesKey)) |>
    distinct(area, speciesKey),
  "Vascular plants (Tracheophyta)" = area_occurrences |>
    filter(kingdom == "Plantae", phylum == "Tracheophyta", !is.na(speciesKey)) |>
    distinct(area, speciesKey)
)

scope_overlap <- imap_dfr(scope_presence_list, \(presence, scope_name) {
  per_key <- count(presence, speciesKey)
  per_area <- count(presence, area, name = "sp")
  isalo_species <- per_area$sp[per_area$area == "Isalo"]
  makay_species <- per_area$sp[per_area$area == "Makay"]
  shared <- sum(per_key$n == 2)
  union <- nrow(per_key)
  tibble(
    scope_name,
    isalo_species,
    makay_species,
    shared,
    union,
    jaccard = shared / union,
    sorensen = 2 * shared / (isalo_species + makay_species)
  )
})
```

```{r}
scope_overlap |>
  mutate(across(c(isalo_species, makay_species, shared, union), comma)) |>
  mutate(across(c(jaccard, sorensen), \(x) percent(x, accuracy = 0.1))) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Recorded-species overlap between areas, by taxonomic scope (accepted species)")
```

```{r}
venn_polygons <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    x = -0.8 + 1.6 * cos(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 360)),
    y = 1.6 * sin(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 360)),
    set = "Isalo"
  ),
  tibble(
    x = 0.8 + 1.6 * cos(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 360)),
    y = 1.6 * sin(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 360)),
    set = "Makay"
  )
)

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = venn_polygons,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = set, fill = set),
    color = "#1f1f1f",
    alpha = 0.45,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = -1.9, y = 0, label = comma(sum(unique_species$area == "Isalo")), size = 7) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = comma(shared_species_count), size = 7) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.9, y = 0, label = comma(sum(unique_species$area == "Makay")), size = 7) +
  annotate("text", x = -1.85, y = 1.85, label = "Isalo", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.85, y = 1.85, label = "Makay", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Isalo = area_colors[["Isalo"]], Makay = area_colors[["Makay"]])) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Accepted-species overlap between the two protected areas",
    subtitle = "Counts based on GBIF backbone speciesKey after exact polygon filtering (all taxa)"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

Jaccard similarity (all taxa): `r percent(overlap_metrics$jaccard_similarity[[1]], accuracy = 0.1)`.

## Class representation

The figure shows the twelve classes contributing the most accepted species
across the two areas combined.

```{r}
class_comparison <- area_occurrences |>
  filter(!is.na(speciesKey), !is.na(class)) |>
  distinct(area, class, speciesKey) |>
  count(area, class, name = "species_count")

top_classes <- class_comparison |>
  summarise(total_species = sum(species_count), .by = class) |>
  slice_max(total_species, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(total_species) |>
  pull(class)

class_plot_data <- class_comparison |>
  filter(class %in% top_classes) |>
  complete(area, class = top_classes, fill = list(species_count = 0)) |>
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = top_classes))

ggplot(class_plot_data, aes(x = species_count, y = class, fill = area)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ area) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = area_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Accepted species richness by class",
    x = "Species count",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Sensitivity analysis

The robustness of the main contrast was tested by recomputing counts under
alternative record filters: excluding the largest dataset(s) of each area,
restricting to preserved specimens, and filtering on coordinate uncertainty
(available for only ~7% of records in both areas).

```{r}
top_dataset_by_area <- dataset_stats |> group_by(area) |> slice_head(n = 1) |> ungroup()
top3_by_area <- dataset_stats |> group_by(area) |> slice_head(n = 3) |> ungroup()

sensitivity_filters <- list(
  list(id = "S1", label = "Baseline (no exclusion)", f = function(d) d),
  list(id = "S2", label = "Excluding largest dataset per area", f = function(d)
    d |> anti_join(top_dataset_by_area |> select(area, datasetKey), by = c("area", "datasetKey"))),
  list(id = "S3", label = "Excluding three largest datasets per area", f = function(d)
    d |> anti_join(top3_by_area |> select(area, datasetKey), by = c("area", "datasetKey"))),
  list(id = "S4", label = "Preserved specimens only", f = function(d)
    d |> filter(basisOfRecord == "PRESERVED_SPECIMEN")),
  list(id = "S5", label = "Excluding uncertainty > 1,000 m (unknowns kept)", f = function(d)
    d |> filter(is.na(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters) | coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= 1000)),
  list(id = "S6", label = "Known uncertainty <= 10,000 m only (unknowns excluded)", f = function(d)
    d |> filter(!is.na(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters), coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= 10000)),
  list(id = "S7", label = "Excluding iNaturalist", f = function(d)
    d |> filter(datasetKey != "50c9509d-22c7-4a22-a47d-8c48425ef4a7"))
)

sensitivity_results <- map_dfr(sensitivity_filters, \(fltr) {
  fltr$f(area_occurrences) |>
    summarise(
      occurrences = n(),
      species_all = n_distinct(speciesKey[!is.na(speciesKey)]),
      species_vascular = n_distinct(speciesKey[!is.na(speciesKey) & kingdom == "Plantae" & phylum == "Tracheophyta"]),
      .by = area
    ) |>
    mutate(filter_id = fltr$id, filter_label = fltr$label)
}) |>
  left_join(protected_areas |> st_drop_geometry() |> select(area, AREA_KM2), by = "area") |>
  mutate(
    occ_density = occurrences / AREA_KM2 * 100,
    species_density = species_all / AREA_KM2 * 100
  )

sensitivity_wide <- sensitivity_results |>
  select(-AREA_KM2) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = area, values_from = c(occurrences, occ_density, species_all, species_density, species_vascular)) |>
  mutate(
    occ_density_ratio = occ_density_Isalo / occ_density_Makay,
    species_density_ratio = species_density_Isalo / species_density_Makay,
    raw_species_ratio = species_all_Isalo / species_all_Makay,
    vascular_species_ratio = species_vascular_Isalo / species_vascular_Makay
  )
```

```{r}
sensitivity_wide |>
  transmute(
    filter_id,
    filter_label,
    `Isalo occ.` = comma(occurrences_Isalo),
    `Makay occ.` = comma(occurrences_Makay),
    `Isalo sp.` = comma(species_all_Isalo),
    `Makay sp.` = comma(species_all_Makay),
    `Vasc. sp. Isalo` = comma(species_vascular_Isalo),
    `Vasc. sp. Makay` = comma(species_vascular_Makay),
    `Occ. density ratio` = round(occ_density_ratio, 1),
    `Sp. density ratio` = round(species_density_ratio, 1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Sensitivity of the Makay/Isalo contrast to alternative record filters")
```

The occurrence-density contrast (Isalo/Makay) remains between ~34× and ~47×
under every filter, and the species-density contrast between ~4× and ~16×:
the conclusion that GBIF documentation is heavily unequal is robust. Two
results qualify it: (i) restricted to **preserved specimens**, Makay holds
more occurrences (5,995 vs 4,955) and more species (727 vs 668) than Isalo —
the asymmetry is specific to recent molecular bulk-sampling and checklist
campaigns; and (ii) excluding Makay's dominant datasets hits Makay harder
(72% of its records sit in its top three datasets, vs 61% in Isalo).

## Audit notes

Differences from the earlier version of this report:

1. **Species counting.** The `coalesce(species, scientificName)` label method
   counted higher-rank identifications as species; accepted species are now
   counted with `speciesKey`. The earlier headline counts (2,768 Isalo /
   1,274 Makay) mix species with family-, order- and genus-level labels.
2. **Parquet conversion defects.** The superseded converter (a) silently
   dropped 300,486 of 3,635,415 records because 262 malformed-quote records
   desynchronised readr's chunked reader, and (b) created 70,239,134 all-NA
   phantom rows via `NA`-propagating logical subsetting. The earlier
   "Madagascar present records = 73,144,444" figure was the sum of real and
   phantom rows; the correct figure is 3,635,415. Area-level results used
   only records with coordinates, so earlier occurrence counts were valid but
   undercounted (Isalo 49,606 → 53,115; Makay 6,692 → 7,341).
3. **Area computation.** Areas are now computed in the ellipsoidal equal-area
   projection EPSG:6933, reproducing WDPA's own `GIS_AREA` (866.5 km² Isalo,
   4,056.4 km² Makay). Earlier figures used EPSG:29702 (Laborde: 865.7 /
   4,052.4) or geodesic area on WGS84 (868.7 / 4,067.5); all three are within
   ~0.5% of one another.
4. **Unreproducible legacy figures.** The companion interpretation note
   reported 2,749 species for Isalo and 1,293 for Makay. These values could
   not be reproduced from any preserved artifact (RDS, CSV outputs, or this
   report's code) and are inconsistent with all of them (which agree on
   2,768/1,274 for the legacy method); they are superseded and should not be
   cited.
5. **IUCN red-list categories** are absent from the SIMPLE_CSV download
   format; the earlier report's IUCN table was uninformative for that reason
   and is not reproduced here.
